segments.contextAfter: A view that is repeatedly added and removed from a window during live resize will receive only one [`viewWillStartLiveResize()`](nsview/viewwillstartliveresize().md) (on the first time it is added to the window) and one [`viewDidEndLiveResize()`](nsview/viewdidendliveresize().md) (when the window has completed the live resize operation).
